BLOG

Scaling Git for the agentic software factory

19.5

What's new in GitLab

BUILD WITH GITLAB

Ship faster.
Stay in control.

AI ORCHESTRATION

Define how teams and AI agents work together

Teams orchestrate, agents execute, turning issues into merge requests, remediating vulnerabilities, and reviewing code, all inside the guardrails you set.

Learn about GitLab Duo

PLATFORM

Your end-to-end delivery process in one place

Planning, source control, and CI/CD in one platform. Projects, releases, and code share one data plane, so your team and agents work from a single source of truth.

Explore our platform

SECURITY

Be proactive with security built in, not bolted on

Scanning, policies, and approvals run inside the pipeline, not beside it. Findings land in the merge request, and the audit evidence writes itself as the change moves.

Learn more about security

GITLAB FLEX

Commit once, adjust anytime with flexible pricing

Organizations that need pricing flexibility can make one annual commitment and steer their spend across seat-based licenses and usage-based credits without re-procurement.

Discover GitLab Flex
One control plane

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for teams that won't compromise on speed or control as they scale agentic software engineering.

01
One source of context

Every project, issue, and pipeline in one place. Agents work from the same source your team gates, no exceptions.

02
Security and governance

Policies, approvals, and scanning apply to human and agent changes alike. The same gates, no exceptions.

03
Traceability you can audit

Every agent action shows up in the audit trail. No black box, no guessing what changed or who approved it.

MIGRATE TODAY

Talk to sales
Built to meet your
industry’s demands

Every industry faces unique security, compliance, and delivery requirements. GitLab adapts to your regulatory environment while maintaining the velocity your teams need.

FINANCIAL SERVICES

Audit trails, access controls, and security testing that satisfy regulators without slowing delivery.

1M
developer hours saved per year

PUBLIC SECTOR

Federal security standards, air-gapped deployment, and compliance evidence by default.

13x
faster security scanning

TELECOMMUNICATIONS

Scale network infrastructure with confidence. Support complex deployment pipelines, strict uptime requirements, and distributed edge environments.

6x
faster time to market

AUTOMOTIVE

Automated safety-standard compliance for embedded development and globally distributed teams.

99%
shorter feedback loops

EDUCATION

Research collaboration and student access, with institutional data protected.

60%
reduction in manual tasks

AEROSPACE

Flight-critical firmware to customer apps, with SBOM tracking and airgap deployment.

80x
faster CI pipeline builds

Use left and right arrow keys to navigate quotes. Swipe on touch devices.

Quote 1 of 6

1 / 6

//
GitLab is helping us catch security flaws early, and it's integrated into the developer's flow.

“An engineer can push code, get immediate feedback from cascading audit steps, and see if there's a vulnerability built in there.”

Mitch Trale
Head of Infrastructure

//
We were able to quadruple the number of builds per night, ultimately improving build success from 60% to 90%.

“As a result, the customer is receiving new capabilities sooner and with better quality.”

Alan Hohn
Director, Software Strategy

//
The faster deployment capabilities GitLab enables directly contribute to our business growth.

“Communications service providers choose us because we can deliver innovation at the speed their markets demand.”

Daniel Costa Soares
Head of Software Automation and Support

//
By integrating AI into the developer workflow, our teams are writing better code, faster.

“Our developers are experiencing meaningful productivity gains, freeing them up to focus on higher-value problem solving.”

Chris Hutchison
Director, Enterprise Toolchain

//
GitLab is helping Nasdaq achieve its vision of becoming 100% cloud

“...by operating at DevOps speed and getting projects out to the cloud quickly, reliably, and with quality.”

Stephen Cooper
Sr Director of Software Engineering

//
With GitLab CI/CD, we are able to complete 1.5 million builds every month.

“Using GitLab, our teams can work on the same project and share code within minutes.”

Fabio Huser
Software Architect
Latest from GitLab

WHAT'S NEW

GitLab 19.5: Connect agents, secure secrets, and route reviews

Connect any MCP-compatible agent to GitLab, keep secrets under your existing permissions, and get every merge request to the right reviewer, faster.

BLOG

When code is abundant

Why GitLab's CEO believes the winners in the agentic software era will be the ones who solve for trust, not just speed.

BLOG

Open weight models, now on GitLab

Pick the right model for each job. Balance quality, speed, and cost, all within your guardrails.

START BUILDING FASTER TODAY

Own what’s next
